description:
[0.98a] ExchangeRefit v1.3.0 - Advanced Ship Layout Copier/Paster & Live Scanner Diagnostics
Author: Anjasnare
Game Version: Starsector 0.98a-RC8 (Utility Mod - Safe to add/remove mid-save)
Compatibility: Fully integrated and synchronized with Advanced Gunnery Control, Progressive S-Mods & Version Checker

Description
Tired of manually rebuilding your ships every time you buy a new hull? Annoyed by keyboard hotkey conflicts from older scripts?

ExchangeRefit adds a fully interactive, mouse-driven shipyard terminal directly inside any orbital station or planet dialogue menu => Press "x".

after update 1.4.1 now just press K in space to get access.   It allows you to copy, save, and apply complete ship layouts (Weapons, Flux Vents, Capacitors, Hullmods, and S-Mods) seamlessly using your fleet cargo resources.

Since layouts are saved as standalone lightweight text files, you can easily send them to your friends to share your best builds!

Key Features
- Full Mouse UI Integration: Accessible natively from any market dock via conversation choices. No more blind keypresses while flying in space!
- 13 Archive Slots per Hull: Keep up to 13 customized loadouts for every single ship hull in the game (spread over 2 neat pages).
- Real Cargo and Resource Management: Automatically unmounts old weapons back into your cargo (no lost items). It safely checks your inventory and consumes the required weapons or fighters from your fleet soute upon pasting (prevents cheating).
- Advanced Gunnery Control Sync: Automatically backs up and restores your custom Weapon AI priorities, targeting behaviors, and automated fire group settings on the fly.
- Multiplayer Build Sharing: Blueprints are saved in the common saves folder. Share them via Discord or forums, allowing other players to instantly drop your loadouts into their own fleets!

---

What's New in v1.3.0 (The Diagnostics & Performance Update)

Live Hull Scanner Diagnostic: Selecting a ship now triggers a comprehensive, live diagnostic scan displaying real-time Deployment Points (DP), Shield Type, Top Speed, Structural Hull/Armor ratings, and an accurate remaining/total OP counter.
Dynamic Tactical Color Palette: Mounted weapons in your terminal are now automatically sorted by size and color-coded by damage type for a swift tactical read (Red-Coral for High Explosive, Beige/White for Kinetic, Royal Blue for Energy, and Yellow for Fragmentation).
Modular Custom Setup (Paste Filters): A completely overhauled configuration screen featuring independent toggle switches [ON]/[OFF] for Weapons, Standard Hullmods, S-Mods, AGC configurations, Fighters, Groups, Officer assignment, and Additional Refit Upgrades (station infrastructure tags). Sections adapt dynamically to the screen; unselected components automatically hide themselves to prevent text clutter!
Progressive S-Mods Native Synergy: Fully synchronized with Progressive S-Mods mechanics. Toggling the new Additional Upgrades switch safely backs up and restores your hull's progressive experience (XP) tags and milestones without breaking progression tracking.
Advanced S-Mod Workshop Tools: Enhanced "Strip S-Mods" sub-menu with two reliable commands: Option 1 completely wipes them for a 100% Story Points refund. Option 2 downgrades them to standard Hullmods while keeping them equipped (automatically blocks execution and displays precise OP cost requirements if ship capacity is insufficient).
Anti-Crash Engine Overhaul & Security Compliance: Core code completely refactored into lightweight decentralized sub-modules to stay strictly within Janino's compilation buffer limits. Removed all reflection-based loops and localized time/date API logic to natively satisfy Starsector's strict sandbox security policies and prevent random desktop crashes when interacting with transient refit clones.
Version Checker Support: Full metadata integration. The mod is now natively discovered and monitored by the Version Checker utility mod.

How to Use the Terminal

1. Dock at any station or planetary market.
2. Click the option: "Access ExchangeRefit Terminal (Manage Blueprints)".

1/2 : press K in space to get acces for Exchangerefit (update1.4.1)
3. Select your hull, pick one of the 13 archive slots, review the clear live data checklist, and manage your loadouts cleanly!

How to Share Loadouts Between Players
To Export/Send a build:
1. Save your ship layout in-game on any Slot (like Slot 1).
2. Go to your main Starsector directory, then open the folder: saves / common
3. Locate the file named: ExchangeRefit_HullId_Slot1.txt
4. Send this file to your friend (via Discord, Email, etc.).

To Import/Receive a build:
1. Download your friend text file and place it inside your own saves / common directory.
2. (Optional) You can rename Slot1 in the filename to Slot3 if you want to place it in your 3rd slot!
3. Open the game, access the ExchangeRefit terminal at any station, select the matching ship hull, and click Paste!

Author Note
As this is my very first mod, I am fully committed to improving and maintaining ExchangeRefit! I will be deeply attentive to all feedback, bug reports, feature suggestions, and critiques, as long as they remain constructive. Let us make this tool better together!

Installation
1. Download the zip file from the official Release repository.
2. Extract the ExchangeRefit folder into your Starsector / mods / directory.
3. Enable ExchangeRefit in the Starsector launcher.
4. Enjoy your smooth refitting sessions!

DOWNLOAD LINK :
https://github.com/I3Well/ExchangeRefit/releases#release-v1.4.1
